Container.Name: server-assistant
Container.Overview: Unraid-resident diagnostic and control dashboard, plus a stateless MCP endpoint for your own LLM. No inference ships in the container itself.
Container.Description: Server Assistant reads Unraid array/share/container/host state (via unraid-api's GraphQL and a read-only /var/local/emhttp mount) and exposes it two ways: a live dashboard for humans, and a stateless MCP tool/resource surface for an LLM client you already run. Every mutating action goes through a two-phase human Approval gate, hash-bound argument-free scripts, and a mandatory dry run before it can touch the host — see the Support link for the full safety model. The container mounts /var/run/docker.sock read-only for future container-control actions; this is a distribution convenience, not a security boundary — read the docker-compose.yml comment or the project's issue #52 before relying on container isolation alone.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Dashboard/MCP HTTP port. Default host port is 8099, not 8080 — 8080 is commonly already taken by other containers (binhex-qbittorrentvpn on the reference host); pick any free host port.

Config.Name: Unraid INI State
Config.Description: Read-only fallback state source (array/disk/share INI files). Never write here.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Root-equivalent even mounted read-only: a process reaching this socket could run a privileged container and control the whole host. This is NOT a sandbox boundary — the real safety rails are the app's own Approval gate, hash-bound scripts, and mandatory dry run. See docker-compose.yml's comment or issue #52 before assuming isolation.

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: YAML config (schema in internal/config). Copy deploy/docker/config.docker.yaml here and edit graphql_url for your LAN.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite state and the harness audit trail. Persisted across container recreation.

Config.Name: Unraid API Key
Config.Description: VIEWER-role unraid-api key. Create with: unraid-api apikey --create --name server-assistant --roles VIEWER (see docs/DEPLOY-UNRAID.md). Never share or commit this value.
